newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan to submit ADNOC term jet A-1 bids by May 21.
newsitem.headline: Japan to submit ADNOC term jet A-1 bids by May 21.

text.p: Abu Dhabi has asked three of its Japanese jet A-1 customers to submit by May 21 their bids for a one-year supply contract starting in July, traders said on Monday.

Initial bids are expected to be lower than the current premium of 75 cents per barrel, as some recent jet A-1 spot deals are believed to have been done at prices as low as 10 to 20 cents over the mean of Middle Eastern quotes, they said.

Abu Dhabi National Oil Co (ADNOC) and two Japanese refiners, who have term contracts which start in April, agreed earlier this year to raise this year's term premium by 5 cents per barrel to 80 cents.
The three firms with supply contracts starting in July are expected to import an annual combined total of about 2.4 million barrels of jet A-1 cargoes, traders said.
